title: Compactly supported direct image commutes with extension of coefficients
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$. Work in the standing scheme setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]: $X$, $Y$, and $\bar X$ are separated schemes of finite type over $k$, and all maps are $k$-morphisms. Let $f:X\to Y$ have a compactification $f=\bar f\circ j$, where $j:X\hookrightarrow\bar X$ is open and $\bar f:\bar X\to Y$ is proper. Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of finite commutative rings killed by a power of $\ell$.

Use the ordinary uncompleted module derived categories and constant coefficient sheaves of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $\Dctf(T_{\mathrm{proét}},R)$ for the full subcategory with bounded, intrinsically constructible cohomology [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf] and finite Tor amplitude [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. Write $K_B=K\otimes^L_{A_T}B_T$ with its $B_T$-action as in [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor], and $Rf_{!,R}=R\bar f_{*,R}j_{!,R}$, with extension by zero as in [def-weil-extension-by-zero].

For $M\in\Dctf(X_{\mathrm{proét}},A)$ the canonical coefficient comparison is an isomorphism, natural in $M$, in $\Dctf(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},B)$:
$$
b_{A,B}(M):(Rf_{!,A}M)_B=(R\bar f_{*,A}j_{!,A}M)\otimes^L_{A_Y}B_Y
\xrightarrow{\sim}R\bar f_{*,B}j_{!,B}(M\otimes^L_{A_X}B_X)=Rf_{!,B}(M_B).
$$
Here the proper comparison is the $B$-linear adjoint transpose of the $A$-counit after extension of scalars, followed by the canonical extension-by-zero tensor comparison; the derived adjunctions are those of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. There is no flatness or finite projective dimension hypothesis on $B$ over $A$.

For every further homomorphism $B\to C$ of finite commutative $\ell$-primary rings, the comparison for $A\to C$ satisfies
$$
b_{A,C}(M)\circ\alpha_{Rf_{!,A}M}
=Rf_{!,C}(\alpha_M)\circ b_{B,C}(M_B)\circ(b_{A,B}(M))_C,
$$
where $\alpha_K:(K_B)_C\xrightarrow{\sim}K_C$ is the associativity isomorphism of [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor].

proof.text: Put $p=\bar f$, $N=j_!^AM$, and use the natural maps $\gamma,e,b=Rp_{*,B}(e)\gamma$ of [def-sp-reduction-direct-image-comparison]. By [lem-sp-supported-etale-tensor-origin], choose bounded etale $K,H=K\otimes_A^LB$ with $\nu^*K\simeq N$ and $\nu^*H\simeq N\otimes_A^LB$.

source.place: Step 1: construction and bounded etale inputs

proof.text: By [lem-kun-0f10] and [def-kun-cd], $p$ has one torsion abelian bound $c$. The module/abelian derived comparison identifies underlying $R^qp_{*,A}F$ with $R^qp_*F$ for every module sheaf $F$; $F$ is $\ell$-primary torsion, so this vanishes for $q>c$. Also $A$ is Noetherian (its ideal set is finite), and $B$ is finitely presented over $A$: a finite free surjection onto the finite set $B$ has finite kernel. Thus [lem-sf-projection-finite-constant] applied to bounded $K$ makes the etale counit projection $\pi_K$ invertible.

source.place: Steps 2-3: the unchanged finite-window projection tool

proof.text: After restriction of scalars and its direct-image isomorphism $d$, [lem-sp-direct-image-change-ring-transpose] identifies $d\,r(\gamma_N)$ by transpose $\varepsilon_N\otimes1$. Since $K,H\in D^+$, [lem-sp-direct-image-etale-mate-isomorphism] gives the same transpose for the invertible transport of $\pi_K$. Injectivity of adjunction makes these maps equal. Restriction reflects isomorphisms, hence $\gamma_N$ is invertible; so is $b=Rp_{*,B}(e)\gamma_N$.

source.place: Step 3: identify the specified B-linear comparison

proof.text: The restricted $Rf_!$ adjunction gives $Rf_{!,A}M$ and $Rf_{!,B}M_B$ in their respective $\Dctf$ categories. Scalar extension preserves $\Dctf$, so the source belongs too. Fullness gives the claimed isomorphism there; naturality is part of the comparison construction.

For $A\to B\to C$, apply the proper scalar cocycle at $N$ and the open scalar cocycle at $M$. Write $T=T^{B,C}$ and suppress only the associators in these two equations. Naturality of $\gamma^{B,C}$ at $e^{A,B}_M$ gives
$$\begin{aligned}
b_{B,C}(M_B)T(b_{A,B}(M))
&=Rp_C(e^{B,C})\gamma^{B,C}T(Rp_Be^{A,B})T(\gamma^{A,B})\\
&=Rp_C(e^{B,C})Rp_C(Te^{A,B})\gamma^{B,C}T(\gamma^{A,B})\\
&=Rp_C(e^{A,C})\gamma^{A,C}=b_{A,C}(M).
\end{aligned}$$
Reinserting the two cocycles' associators and using naturality of $\alpha$ yields exactly $b_{A,C}\alpha_{Rf_{!,A}M}=Rf_{!,C}(\alpha_M)b_{B,C}(M_B)(b_{A,B}(M))_C$.
